title: NOAA: Challenger Deep is 10,935 meters deep
summary: The same NOAA page says the deepest place it states is 10,935 meters, in the Mariana Trench at Challenger Deep.
body: NOAA Ocean Exploration says the deepest place in the ocean measures 10,935 meters, or 35,876 feet, in the Pacific Ocean's Mariana Trench at a place called Challenger Deep. The page says the bottom is not flat, so depth varies. This is the depth that page states, not a claim that every later survey prints the same meter.
